    "/api/v1/health": {
      "get": {
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "All services are healthy and operational.",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "ok",
                        "error"
                      ],
                      "description": "The overall status of the application.",
                      "example": "ok"
                    },
                    "timestamp": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "description": "The ISO 8601 timestamp when the check was performed."
                    },
                    "services": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "api": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "status": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "enum": [
                                "healthy",
                                "unhealthy"
                              ]
                            },
                            "message": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "description": "An optional message, usually present on failure.",
                              "example": "Connection timed out"
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "status"
                          ],
                          "title": "ServiceStatus",
                          "description": "The status of a service",
                          "example": {
                            "status": "healthy"
                          }
                        },
                        "database": {
                          "type": "object",

                          "example": {
                            "status": "healthy"
                          }
                        },
                        "cache": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "status": {
                              "type": "string",

                                "healthy",

                              "type": "string",

                              "example": "Connection timed out"

    "/api/v1/otp": {
      "get": {
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Mobile number containing 10 digits",
              "example": "9876543210"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "Mobile number containing 10 digits",
            "name": "mobileNumber",
            "in": "query"
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Send OTP to the mobile number",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the OTP was sent successfully",
                      "example": true
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Bad Request",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Bad Request"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "500": {
            "description": "Internal Server Error",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Internal Server Error"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },

    "/api/v1/callback/inout": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "callback"
        ],
        "summary": "Inout callback",
        "description": "Inout callback. Used for callback data from inout.",
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "action": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "init",
                      "bet",
                      "withdraw",
                      "rollback"
                    ]
                  },
                  "token": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "data": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {

                    },
                    "additionalProperties": {
                      "nullable": true
                    }
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "action",
                  "token",
                  "data"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "nullable": true
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Inout callback",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "code": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "OK",
                        "TEMPORARY_ERROR",
                        "INVALID_TOKEN",
                        "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
                        "ACCOUNT_INVALID",
                        "UNKNOWN_ERROR",
                        "GAME_DISABLED",
                        "INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS",
                        "CHECKS_FAIL",
                        "DEBIT_TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND"
                      ]
                    },
                    "message": {
                      "type": "string"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "code"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": {
                    "nullable": true
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "500": {
            "description": "Internal Server Error",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Internal Server Error"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "/api/v1/auth/login": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "auth"
        ],
        "description": "Login a user",
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "mobileNumber": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Mobile number containing 10 digits",
                    "example": "9876543210"
                  },
                  "password": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Password",
                    "example": "Password123!"
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "mobileNumber",
                  "password"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "The login endpoint will set auth cookie automatically",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the login was successful",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "token": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "JWT token for authentication. No need to actively use this as auth cookie is automatically set upon login",
                      "example": "1234567890"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "token"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Bad Request",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Bad Request"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "Unauthorized",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Unauthorized"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "500": {
            "description": "Internal Server Error",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Internal Server Error"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "/api/v1/auth/register": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "auth"
        ],
        "description": "Register a new user",
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "username": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "minLength": 3,
                    "maxLength": 20,
                    "description": "Username must be at least 3 characters long",
                    "example": "john_doe"
                  },
                  "password": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "minLength": 8,
                    "description": "Password must be at least 8 characters long and must contain at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character",
                    "example": "Password123!",
                    "title": "Password"
                  },
                  "mobileNumber": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Mobile number containing 10 digits",
                    "example": "9876543210"
                  },
                  "otp": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^\\d{6}$",
                    "description": "OTP must be a 6-digit number",
                    "example": "123456"
                  },
                  "referredBy": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Referral code of the user who referred you",
                    "example": "1234567890"
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "username",
                  "password",
                  "mobileNumber",
                  "otp"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "The register endpoint will set auth cookie automatically",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the registration was successful",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "token": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "JWT token for authentication. No need to actively use this as auth cookie is automatically set upon registration",
                      "example": "1234567890"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "token"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Bad Request",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Bad Request"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"

    "/api/v1/user/queries": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "user"
        ],
        "summary": "Submit a query",
        "description": "Submit a new customer support query. A unique ticket ID will be generated for tracking.",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "DEPOSIT",
                      "WITHDRAWAL",
                      "BANK_CHANGE",
                      "BONUS"
                    ],
                    "description": "Query type",
                    "example": "DEPOSIT"
                  },
                  "subject": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "minLength": 5,
                    "maxLength": 200,
                    "description": "Query subject (5-200 characters)",
                    "example": "Deposit not credited to account"
                  },
                  "details": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "additionalProperties": {
                      "nullable": true
                    },
                    "description": "Query details as key-value pairs",
                    "example": {
                      "amount": 1000,
                      "transactionId": "TXN123456",
                      "paymentMethod": "UPI",
                      "description": "Paid via UPI but amount not reflected in balance"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "type",
                  "subject",
                  "details"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Query submitted successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the query was submitted successfully",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "message": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Result message",
                      "example": "Query submitted successfully"
                    },
                    "query": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "ticketId": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "status": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "subject": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "createdAt": {
                          "type": "string"
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "id",
                        "ticketId",
                        "type",
                        "status",
                        "subject",
                        "createdAt"
                      ]
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "message",
                    "query"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Bad Request",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Bad Request"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",

    "/api/v1/wingo/bet": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "wingo"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",

            },

            "name": "auth-token",

        "requestBody": {
          "content": {

                    "type": "string",

                    "example": "147f8c93-b8c2-4435-8534-9ac4ad282ca5"
                  },
                  "betType": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "COLOR",
                      "NUMBER",
                      "SIZE"
                    ],
                    "description": "Type of bet",
                    "example": "COLOR"
                  },
                  "betChoice": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Bet choice (RED/GREEN/VIOLET for COLOR, 0-9 for NUMBER, BIG/SMALL for SIZE)",
                    "example": "RED"
                  },
                  "betAmount": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "maximum": 10000,
                    "description": "Bet amount",
                    "example": 100
                  }

                "required": [
                  "periodId",
                  "betType",
                  "betChoice",
                  "betAmount"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "201": {
            "description": "Bet placed successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the bet was placed successfully",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "bet": {
                      "type": "object",

                        "id": {

                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Period number",
                          "example": "2024010115001"
                        },
                        "betAmount": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Original bet amount",
                          "example": 100
                        },
                        "contractAmount": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Contract amount (after service fee)",
                          "example": 98
                        },
                        "betType": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "COLOR",
                            "NUMBER",
                            "SIZE"
                          ],
                          "description": "Type of bet",
                          "example": "COLOR"
                        },
                        "betChoice": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Bet choice",
                          "example": "RED"
                        },
                        "status": {

    "/api/v1/k3/bet": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "k3"
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "periodId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "format": "uuid",
                    "description": "Period ID to bet on",
                    "example": "147f8c93-b8c2-4435-8534-9ac4ad282ca5"
                  },
                  "betType": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "SUM",
                      "TRIPLE_ANY",
                      "TRIPLE_SPECIFIC",
                      "DOUBLE_ANY",
                      "DOUBLE_SPECIFIC",
                      "ALL_DIFFERENT",
                      "TWO_NUMBERS",
                      "CONSECUTIVE",
                      "BIG",
                      "SMALL",
                      "ODD",
                      "EVEN"
                    ],
                    "description": "Type of bet",
                    "example": "BIG"
                  },
                  "betChoice": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Bet choice - format depends on bet type (e.g., '12' for SUM, '3' for TRIPLE_SPECIFIC, '4,4,6' for DOUBLE_SPECIFIC, '2,5' for TWO_NUMBERS)",
                    "example": "12"
                  },
                  "betAmount": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "maximum": 10000,
                    "description": "Bet amount",
                    "example": 100
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "periodId",
                  "betType",
                  "betChoice",
                  "betAmount"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "201": {
            "description": "Bet placed successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",

                      "example": true
                    },

                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "string",

                          "example": "147f8c93-b8c2-4435-8534-9ac4ad282ca5"
                        },
                        "periodId": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "uuid",
                          "description": "Period ID",
                          "example": "147f8c93-b8c2-4435-8534-9ac4ad282ca5"
                        },
                        "periodNumber": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Period number",
                          "example": "2024010115001"
                        },
                        "betAmount": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Original bet amount",
                          "example": 100
                        },
                        "contractAmount": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Contract amount (after service fee)",
                          "example": 98
                        },
                        "betType": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "SUM",
                            "TRIPLE_ANY",
                            "TRIPLE_SPECIFIC",
                            "DOUBLE_ANY",
                            "DOUBLE_SPECIFIC",
                            "ALL_DIFFERENT",
                            "TWO_NUMBERS",
                            "CONSECUTIVE",
                            "BIG",
                            "SMALL",
                            "ODD",
                            "EVEN"
                          ],
                          "description": "Type of bet",
                          "example": "BIG"
                        },
                        "betChoice": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Bet choice",
                          "example": "12"

                        "status": {

    "/api/v1/inout/games": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "inout"
        ],
        "summary": "Get Inout games list",
        "description": "Retrieve list of Inout games with pagination and category filter",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "exclusiveMinimum": true,
              "default": 1,
              "description": "Page number",
              "example": 1
            },
            "required": false,
            "description": "Page number",
            "name": "page",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "exclusiveMinimum": true,
              "maximum": 100,
              "default": 20,
              "description": "Items per page (max 100)",
              "example": 20
            },
            "required": false,
            "description": "Items per page (max 100)",
            "name": "limit",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "instant",
                "crash_game",
                "slots",
                "roulette"
              ],
              "description": "Filter by game category",
              "example": "instant"
            },
            "required": false,
            "description": "Filter by game category",
            "name": "category",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Search by game name",

            "required": false,
            "description": "Search by game name",
            "name": "search",
            "in": "query"
          }
        ],
        "responses": {

                          },

                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Game title",
                            "example": "plinko"
                          },

                            "description": "Game description",
                            "example": "plinko description"
                          },
                          "icon": {

                            "example": "https://icons.inout.games/io_sugar-daddy.png"

                          "category": {

                            "description": "Game category",
                            "example": "instant"

                          },
                          "updatedAt": {

                      "type": "boolean",

                    },

    "/api/v1/admin/setResults/fixed": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "admin"
        ],
        "summary": "Get admin-fixed prediction for an active period",
        "description": "Returns the prediction locked by admin for this period (from Redis), if any",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "wingo",
                "k3",
                "5d",
                "moto"
              ],
              "description": "Game key",
              "example": "wingo"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "Game key",
            "name": "game",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid",
              "description": "Active period UUID"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "Active period UUID",
            "name": "periodId",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Fixed prediction (or null if not set)",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "fixed": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "number": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "minimum": 0,
                              "maximum": 9,
                              "description": "Winning number for Wingo",
                              "example": 5
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "number"
                          ],
                          "description": "Result of Wingo game",
                          "example": {
                            "number": 5
                          }
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "dice1": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "minimum": 1,
                              "maximum": 6
                            },
                            "dice2": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "minimum": 1,
                              "maximum": 6
                            },
                            "dice3": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "minimum": 1,
                              "maximum": 6
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "dice1",
                            "dice2",
                            "dice3"
                          ],
                          "description": "Result of K3 dice game",
                          "example": {
                            "dice1": 2,
                            "dice2": 3,
                            "dice3": 6
                          }
                        },
                        {

    "/api/v1/admin/users/create": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "admin"
        ],
        "summary": "Create user",
        "description": "Create a new user",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "username": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "minLength": 3,
                    "description": "Username for the user",
                    "example": "user123"
                  },
                  "password": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "minLength": 8,
                    "description": "Password for the user",
                    "example": "Password123!"
                  },
                  "mobileNumber": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^\\d{10}$",
                    "description": "Mobile number for the user",
                    "example": "9876543210"
                  },
                  "role": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "USER",
                      "AGENT",
                      "SUB_ADMIN",
                      "ADMIN"
                    ],
                    "default": "USER",
                    "description": "Role for the new account (defaults to USER)",
                    "example": "AGENT"
                  },
                  "isDemo": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "default": false,
                    "description": "Is demo account",
                    "example": false
                  },
                  "referredBy": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Referral code used by user",
                    "example": "XYZ789"
                  },
                  "balance": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "default": 0,
                    "description": "Balance for the user",
                    "example": 0
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "username",
                  "password",
                  "mobileNumber"

            "description": "User serial number (numeric string)",
            "name": "serialNumber",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "User mobile number",
              "example": "9876543210"
            },
            "required": false,
            "description": "User mobile number",
            "name": "mobile",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Exact username",
              "example": "user_9855641885"

            "required": false,
            "description": "Exact username",
            "name": "username",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Smart lookup: UUID, serial, mobile, username, or referral code",

            "name": "search",

          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Filter to a specific layer (1–6). Omit for all layers.",
              "example": "1"
            },
            "required": false,
            "description": "Filter to a specific layer (1–6). Omit for all layers.",
            "name": "layer",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {

              "type": "string",

          }

                  "properties": {

                        },

                        "serialNumber",
                        "username",
                        "mobileNumber",
                        "referralCode"
                      ]
                    },
                    "tree": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "User ID",
                            "example": "uuid-123"
                          },

    "/api/v1/admin/users/:id": {

                        },

                          "description": "Username",

                        },

                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Mobile number",

                        },

                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "User balance",
                          "example": 1000.5
                        },

                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Is user banned",
                          "example": false
                        },
                        "isDemo": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Is demo account",
                          "example": false
                        },

                          "description": "User role",
                          "example": "USER"
                        },

                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "User referral code",
                          "example": "ABC123"
                        },
                        "referredBy": {

                          "nullable": true,
                          "description": "Referral code used by user",
                          "example": "XYZ789"
                        },

                          "description": "Account creation timestamp",
                          "example": "2025-01-12T10:30:00Z"

                          "type": "object",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "properties": {
                            "fullName": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "nullable": true
                            },
                            "bankAccount": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "nullable": true
                            },
                            "ifsc": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "nullable": true
                            },
                            "tronAddress": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "nullable": true
                            },
                            "upiId": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "nullable": true
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "fullName",
                            "bankAccount",
                            "ifsc",
                            "tronAddress",
                            "upiId"
                          ],
                          "description": "User bank details"
                        },
                        "stats": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "vipLevel": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "User VIP level (0-10)",
                              "example": 5
                            },
                            "totalCommission": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Total commission earned by the user",
                              "example": 5000.5
                            },
                            "totalRecharge": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Total recharge amount",
                              "example": 5000
                            },
                            "directRecharge": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Direct downlinks (level 1) recharge",
                              "example": 3000
                            },
                            "downlinkRecharge": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "All downlinks (level 1-6) recharge",
                              "example": 8000
                            },
                            "totalWithdraw": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Total withdraw amount",
                              "example": 2000
                            },
                            "directWithdraw": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Direct downlinks (level 1) withdraw",
                              "example": 1500
                            },
                            "downlinkWithdraw": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "All downlinks (level 1-6) withdraw",
                              "example": 4000
                            },
                            "totalBet": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Total bet amount",
                              "example": 10000
                            },
                            "directBet": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Direct downlinks (level 1) bet",
                              "example": 6000
                            },
                            "downlinkBet": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "All downlinks (level 1-6) bet",
                              "example": 20000
                            },
                            "allDownlinksCount": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Total downlinks count (level 1-6)",
                              "example": 45
                            },
                            "directDownlinksCount": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Direct downlinks count (level 1 only)",
                              "example": 10
                            },
                            "totalSubordinatesCount": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Total number of subordinates (1st level + all other levels)",
                              "example": 45
                            },
                            "subordinatesWithFirstDepositCount": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Number of subordinates who made first deposit",
                              "example": 30
                            },
                            "subordinatesWithBetsCount": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "Number of subordinates who placed any bet",
                              "example": 35
                            },
                            "userFirstDeposit": {
                              "type": "number",
                              "description": "First deposit amount of the user",
                              "example": 1000
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "vipLevel",
                            "totalCommission",
                            "totalRecharge",
                            "directRecharge",
                            "downlinkRecharge",
                            "totalWithdraw",
                            "directWithdraw",
                            "downlinkWithdraw",
                            "totalBet",
                            "directBet",
                            "downlinkBet",
                            "allDownlinksCount",
                            "directDownlinksCount",
                            "totalSubordinatesCount",
                            "subordinatesWithFirstDepositCount",
                            "subordinatesWithBetsCount",
                            "userFirstDeposit"
                          ]
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "id",
                        "serialNumber",
                        "username",
                        "mobileNumber",
                        "balance",
                        "isBanned",
                        "isDemo",
                        "role",
                        "referralCode",
                        "referredBy",
                        "createdAt",
                        "bank",
                        "stats"
                      ]
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "user"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {

            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Bad Request"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "success",
                    "error"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "500": {
            "description": "Internal Server Error",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": false
                    },
                    "error": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Error message",
                      "example": "Internal Server Error"
                    }
                  },

                  ]
                }

    "/api/v1/admin/config": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "admin"
        ],
        "summary": "Get configuration",
        "description": "Get the current system configuration",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Configuration retrieved successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the request was successful",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "config": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Config ID",
                          "example": "uuid-123"
                        },
                        "upiIds": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Array of UPI IDs for manual deposits",
                          "example": [
                            "upi@bank",
                            "upi2@bank"
                          ]
                        },
                        "cxpayEnabled": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether CXPAY payment gateway is enabled",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "xdpayEnabled": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether XDPAY payment gateway is enabled",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "oxapayEnabled": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether OXAPAY payment gateway is enabled",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "upiEnabled": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether UPI manual payment is enabled",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "serviceFeePercent": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Service fee percentage",
                          "example": 2
                        },
                        "minDepositAmount": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Minimum deposit amount",
                          "example": 300
                        },
                        "minWithdrawAmount": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Minimum withdrawal amount",
                          "example": 300
                        },
                        "wager": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Wager factor for withdrawal",
                          "example": 1
                        },
                        "maxWithdrawApplicationsPerDay": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Maximum withdrawal applications allowed per day",
                          "example": 3
                        },
                        "announcement": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "description": "Announcement message",
                          "example": "We are currently experiencing technical issues. Please check back later."
                        },
                        "wingoAlgorithm": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "RANDOM",
                            "WINNING",
                            "TRX"
                          ],
                          "description": "Wingo algorithm. Random means the wingo result is random, Winning means the result will try to maximize inhouse profit by choosing the number with least bets on it, TRX means the result is generated from Tron block hashes (same as trxWingo).",
                          "example": "RANDOM"
                        },
                        "maintananceMode": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Maintenance mode",
                          "example": false
                        },
                        "maintananceMessage": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "description": "Maintenance message",
                          "example": "We are currently experiencing technical issues. Please check back later."
                        },
                        "rebatePercent": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Rebate percentage",
                          "example": 0.5
                        },
                        "inrToUsdtPaymentConversionRate": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "INR to USDT conversion rate",
                          "example": 90
                        },
                        "inrToUsdtWithdrawalConversionRate": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "INR to USDT withdrawal conversion rate",
                          "example": 90
                        },
                        "createdAt": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Creation timestamp",
                          "example": "2025-01-12T10:30:00Z"
                        },
                        "updatedAt": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Last update timestamp",
                          "example": "2025-01-12T10:30:00Z"
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "id",
                        "upiIds",

          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "number",
              "nullable": true,
              "default": 30,
              "description": "Number of items per page",
              "example": 30
            },
            "required": false,
            "description": "Number of items per page",
            "name": "limit",
            "in": "query"
          },
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },
            "required": true,
            "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Get gifts",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the gifts were fetched successfully",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "gifts": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The id of the gift",
                            "example": "123456"
                          },
                          "code": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The code of the gift",
                            "example": "123456"
                          },
                          "amount": {
                            "type": "number",
                            "description": "The amount of the gift",
                            "example": 200
                          },
                          "totalRedeemed": {
                            "type": "number",
                            "description": "The total number of times the gift has been redeemed",
                            "example": 50
                          },
                          "totalRedeemable": {
                            "type": "number",
                            "description": "The total number of times the gift can be redeemed",
                            "example": 100
                          },

                            "type": "string",

                              "UPTO"

                            "nullable": true,

    "/api/v1/admin/create": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "admin"
        ],
        "summary": "Create a gift",
        "description": "Create a gift by providing the total redeemable and total amount",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",
              "example": "1234567890"
            },

            "name": "auth-token",
            "in": "cookie"
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "totalRedeemable": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "description": "The total number of times the gift can be redeemed",
                    "example": 5
                  },
                  "amount": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "description": "The amount of the gift. If type is FIXED, this is the amount of each gift. If type is UPTO, this is maximum amount of each gift user can redeem",
                    "example": 100
                  },
                  "type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "FIXED",
                      "UPTO"
                    ],
                    "description": "The type of the gift. FIXED means the amount is fixed for each gift. UPTO means the amount is upto the amount user can redeem",
                    "example": "FIXED"
                  },
                  "validTill": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "format": "date-time",
                    "description": "The date and time until which the gift is valid. If not provided, the gift will be valid forever",
                    "example": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
                  },
                  "validFrom": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "format": "date-time",
                    "description": "The date and time from which the gift is valid. If not provided, the gift will be valid from the current date and time",
                    "example": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
                  },
                  "isActive": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "default": true,
                    "description": "Whether the gift is active. If not provided, the gift will be active",
                    "example": true
                  },
                  "title": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The title of the gift",
                    "example": "Free Gift"
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The description of the gift",
                    "example": "This is a free gift for you"
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "totalRedeemable",
                  "amount",
                  "type"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Create a gift",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "success": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether the gifts were fetched successfully",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "amount": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The amount of each gift",
                      "example": 200
                    },
                    "code": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The redeemable code for the gift",
                      "example": "123456"
                    },
                    "totalRedeemable": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The total number of times the gift can be redeemed",
                      "example": 5
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                    "code",
                    "totalRedeemable"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }

    "/api/v1/admin/illegal-bets/statistics": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "admin"
        ],
        "summary": "Get illegal bets statistics",
        "description": "Get comprehensive statistics for illegal bets including card metrics, violations by game, and risk level analysis",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "JWT token for authentication. This will be automatically set for authenticated users",

                            },
                            "highRisk": {

                            }
                          },
                          "required": [

      "patch": {
        "tags": [
          "admin"
        ],
        "summary": "Manually adjust user turnover",
        "description": "Increase or decrease a user's turnover. `:identifier` accepts any of the three unique user keys: `userId` (UUID), `serialNumber` (integer), or `mobileNumber`.
